name: Speedometer
description: Free GPS speedometer in your browser. Live speed, max and average speed, trip distance and altitude — no app needed.
longDescription: A speedometer that needs no install. It reads device GPS and shows live speed in km/h or mph plus maximum speed, average speed, trip distance and altitude, with a visible GPS accuracy figure so you know when to trust the number.
pricingDetails: Completely free. Your route is never recorded or uploaded.
features: Live GPS speed in km/h or mph
Max, average speed and trip distance
useCases: Checking how far off a car dashboard is
Measuring speed on a boat or tractor
